objective: Al terminar escribes un informe (report) formal con secciones, datos, conclusiones y recomendaciones.

warmup.prompt_es: Un informe presenta información de forma objetiva y ordenada: introducción, hallazgos, conclusiones y recomendaciones. Es un texto muy habitual en el trabajo y en exámenes de B2.

text: Report on Waste Management at Greenfield High School

The purpose of this report is to assess the school's current waste management practices and to recommend improvements. The information was gathered through observation and a survey of 120 students and 15 teachers.

The survey revealed that 70 per cent of students are unaware of the school's recycling policy. Although recycling bins are available in the corridors, they are often contaminated with food waste. In addition, the canteen produces around 50 kilos of food waste per day, much of which could be avoided. Teachers reported that paper is used excessively, with double-sided printing rarely applied.

It is clear that the school lacks both information and infrastructure. While the staff are generally supportive, there is no coordinated programme. Without clear guidance, the situation is unlikely to improve.
It is recommended that the school should:
- launch an awareness campaign led by student representatives;
- install clearly labelled bins in the canteen and classrooms;
- introduce a composting scheme for food waste;
- set double-sided printing as the default option.
If these measures were implemented, waste could be reduced by up to 40 per cent within a year.
input.es: Informe sobre la gestión de residuos en el instituto Greenfield. 1. Introducción: El propósito de este informe es evaluar las prácticas actuales de gestión de residuos del centro y recomendar mejoras. La información se recopiló mediante observación y una encuesta a 120 estudiantes y 15 profesores. 2. Hallazgos: La encuesta reveló que el 70 % de los estudiantes desconoce la política de reciclaje del centro. Aunque hay contenedores en los pasillos, a menudo están contaminados con restos de comida. Además, el comedor produce unos 50 kilos de residuos alimentarios al día, buena parte de los cuales podrían evitarse. Los profesores informaron de que se usa papel en exceso y rara vez se imprime a doble cara. 3. Conclusiones: Está claro que al centro le faltan información e infraestructuras. Aunque el personal es en general favorable, no hay un programa coordinado. Sin una guía clara, es poco probable que la situación mejore. 4. Recomendaciones: Se recomienda que el centro: lance una campaña de concienciación dirigida por representantes estudiantiles; instale contenedores claramente etiquetados en el comedor y las aulas; introduzca un sistema de compostaje para los residuos alimentarios; y fije la impresión a doble cara como opción predeterminada. Si se aplicaran estas medidas, los residuos podrían reducirse hasta un 40 % en un año.

md_es: **Estructura de un informe (report)**
| Sección | Contenido | Frases útiles |
| **Título** | claro, con el tema | *Report on … / A Report into …* |
| **1. Introduction** | propósito y fuentes | *The purpose of this report is to … · The information was gathered through …* |
| **2. Findings** | datos y hallazgos | *The survey revealed that … · It was found that … · X per cent of …* |
| **3. Conclusions** | interpretación | *It is clear that … · It can be concluded that … · The evidence suggests …* |
| **4. Recommendations** | acciones concretas | *It is recommended that … · I would recommend + -ing · The following measures should be taken …* |
**Estilo del informe**
- Registro **formal e impersonal**: *It was found that …* mejor que *I found that …* · Sin contracciones.
- **Pasiva** para procedimientos: *The information was gathered …*
- **Subtítulos** numerados y listas con puntos para recomendaciones.
- **Datos concretos**: porcentajes, cifras, comparaciones.
- **Objetividad**: evita opiniones emocionales; usa *seems, appears, suggests*.
**Verbos útiles**
- *Reveal, show, indicate, suggest, demonstrate, highlight, emphasise, identify, assess, evaluate, recommend, implement.*
**Presentar datos**
- *70 per cent of students are unaware … · The majority / A minority of … · Around half of … · Only a small proportion of …*
**Recomendar**
- *It is recommended that the school (should) + verbo base.* · *I would recommend that + sujeto + verbo base.* · *The school should consider + -ing.*
**Errores típicos**
- ✘ *I think the school is bad.* → ✔ *The survey suggests that the school lacks infrastructure.*
- ✘ *It is recommended to install bins.* (aceptable) → mejor: *It is recommended that bins be installed.* / *that the school install bins.*
- ✘ *The people of the survey said …* → ✔ *Respondents stated that …*
- ✘ *We done a survey.* → ✔ *A survey was carried out.*

**Ojo:** *Report* (informe) ≠ *essay* (ensayo) ≠ *article* (artículo). *Data* suele ser plural en lenguaje formal (*The data show …*); en uso moderno puede ser singular. *Percentage* vs *per cent*: *70 per cent* (UK), *70 percent* (US).
Pronunciación: *survey* (n.) /ˈsɜːveɪ/ · *infrastructure* /ˈɪnfrəstrʌktʃə/ · *implement* /ˈɪmplɪment/.

exercises.prompt: Escribe un informe breve (10 a 12 frases) sobre el uso del transporte público en tu ciudad. Incluye título, introducción, hallazgos con datos inventados, conclusiones y dos recomendaciones. Usa registro formal e impersonal.
model_answer: Report on Public Transport in Riverside
The purpose of this report is to assess the quality of public transport in Riverside. The information was gathered through a survey of 200 residents.

The survey revealed that 65 per cent of respondents use buses at least once a week. However, 58 per cent complained about delays. In addition, only 20 per cent were satisfied with the evening service.
It is clear that the current service does not meet residents' needs, especially at night.
It is recommended that the council should increase the frequency of evening buses and introduce a real-time information app.
